summary: Comprehensive implementation plan for the Fullscreen Media Viewer Overlay Details Drawer in EmreShots. Establishes a true 3-state bottom-anchored overlay drawer (Peek, Medium, Expanded) within the fullscreen Dialog viewer without pushing or restacking the media, completely resolves gesture conflicts between image zoom/pan and drawer scroll, guarantees top toolbar z-order, integrates Overview and Actions tabs with human-readable collection names and verified confirmation dialogs, supports both photos and videos, and adheres to the Emre gallery design language.
